Name: Seasonal Qi Bus
Author: kiwisprinkle
Description:
If you've ever looked at the boring old bus and thought, "Man, I bet Qi could make this look WAY cooler!" then this mod is for you. The bus has transformed to match the Qi aesthetic! The bus is also seasonal, so it should fit right in (well, as much as a giant purple bus can fit in) as you go through your year.

There's recolor compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url], with an additional no snow option that's just a slight blue tint to keep the wintery feel but also spare the eye-strain the snow can cause. Default is set to vanilla coloring, this can be changed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or in the config file :)
